visual_evidence: Candidate c01 (L26_V171, frame 2830) matches the query description: a pot of simmering soup containing shredded ingredients including mushrooms and bamboo shoots is shown on the stove. Beaten egg from a small bowl is poured into the hot broth to create egg strands, and the cook uses a knife to slice tofu directly over the pot so the pieces drop straight into the soup before stirring. Other candidates show related cooking scenes but lack the complete sequence of actions (such as slicing tofu directly overhead into the pot or pouring beaten egg into the shredded mushroom and bamboo soup).
